title: Assent scope and decision object identity
question: Distinguish ordinary tentative assent to a recurring criterion from recognition as a governing expectation. Separate the general criterion, the containing discussion, and unidentified future work. Give exact preferred fields and retain justified alternatives.

title: Same actor repetition and partial support
question: Does later repetition support the entire conditional proposition or only its method? For a same-actor method restatement, determine the recognition profile under the existing codebook; keep interpersonal recognition separate.

title: Observed artifact and complete application
question: Determine what the final spelling artifact and checkbox patch establish. Distinguish observation of the relevant resulting artifact from evidence of a historical transformation and from full fulfillment of all conditions. Do not add new criteria to v0.4.

title: Reported implementation and unmet verification conditions

title: Technical necessity and social expectation
question: Apply v0.4 to Needs rebase and needs a rebase after #26589. Technical necessity alone cannot establish obligation, but a proposed norm need not already be shared. Decide whether a preferred type is justified or alternatives must remain.

title: Focal analytical layer and governance level

title: Targets of challenge

title: Response relations and their direction

title: Ambiguous bot referent

title: Methods and proposed expectations
